title: Nihongo con Teppei — 日常生活の小さなこと (Small Things in Daily Life)
description: From Nihongo con Teppei — the main series for intermediate learners. Teppei talks naturally about small everyday moments: noticing the weather changing, losing track of time, why convenience stores feel comforting. A good stepping stone from N4 Teppei toward fully native-speed content — slightly more complex sentence structures and colloquial connectors than the beginner series.
